text:
alex: Quick sync — who is owning the 09:00 UTC canary window for release train v7 today? Need owners for api-gateway, runtime, and evals + a rollback backup. @maya @pradeep

maya: I can own api-gateway. I'll be on from 08:30–10:00 UTC. Smoke plan: 1) /health, 2) run 50 sample payloads from perf harness, 3) check 95p latency <250ms. Rollback image: `redwood/api:v7.2-canary`. Rollback playbook ready in docs.

pradeep: Taking runtime. Start at 09:00 UTC. Ramp plan: 10% -> 50% over 10m, watch KV cache warmup and GPU mem. Smoke checks: kv sanity, tail logs for OOMs, make sure token latency stays steady. Rollback container: `redwood/runtime:v7.2-canary-fix`. I'll trigger `kubectl rollout undo` if needed.

sarah: I'll run the eval prompt set at ~09:05 and post diffs. Will focus on top-3 critical prompts and reranking stability. Expect results in ~3–5m.

jen: Quick ops note — remember to add the tag `canary-v7` to the routes in the console so SLO dashboards pick it up. Also I'll create the smoke checklist incident doc and link it here before 08:45.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment for `runtime` by pradeep at 09:00:00 UTC. Post-smoke summary will be published to #eng-releases.

maya: :+1: will update gateway routing weights after pradeep's ramp signals.

alex: Confirming no DB schema migrations in this canary, correct? We should avoid migrations in canary windows.

pradeep: Confirmed — no migrations. Only runtime binary and config flags.

sarah: Backup for rollback: @derek said he'd be available as backup from 09:00–10:00. Derek, can you confirm you'll take rollback if needed?

derek: I can be the rollback backup from 09:00–10:00 UTC. I'll monitor #eng-releases and the emergency pager.

jen: Smoke checklist link: http://confluence.internal/redwood/releases/canary-smoke-v7 (I'll populate with exact commands + log grep examples).

alex: Great — I'll update the release banner with owners: api-gateway=@maya, runtime=@pradeep, evals=@sarah, rollback-backup=@derek. If anyone else wants to be backup, say now. Otherwise we'll proceed with the 09:00 canary.

maya: fine by me.

pradeep: ready.

sarah: ready — I'll post the eval diff in-thread when done.

alex: Thanks all — I'll also pin the rollback playbook and the checklist. See you at 09:00 UTC.
